about.title: About me
about.intro: As a certified Fullstack Web Developer, I develop web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular in the frontend, as well as Python, Django and Django REST Framework in the backend. My enthusiasm for software development began at the age of 18 with personal projects, including database-driven applications built with Turbo Pascal and dBASE, and has stayed with me ever since.
about.location: I live near Braunschweig and am open to different working models – from working on-site and hybrid arrangements to remote work. What matters to me is a productive working environment and good communication within the team.
about.learning: I see my current tech stack as a foundation that I want to continuously build on by learning additional programming languages, frameworks and technologies. I use AI purposefully for planning, analysis, development and debugging.
about.problemSolving: When tackling technical tasks, I work analytically and systematically – an approach I have regularly applied in my self-employed work. I break complex tasks into manageable steps, work with a clear plan and look for practical solutions that are as simple as possible. Persistence, creativity and my many years of experience in business, communication, team leadership and collaboration help me along the way.

skills.title: My skills
skills.intro: My tech stack covers frontend, backend, databases, testing and deployment.
skills.description: I enjoy learning new technologies and frameworks and expanding my stack as needed – for example with React.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.intro: Explore a selection of my projects and see how I apply my skills in practice.

coderr.description: Backend for a freelancer developer platform connecting customers with business users and their service offers. The application provides APIs for authentication, user profiles, offers, orders and reviews and integrates with a separately developed frontend.

kanmind.description: Backend for a project management application with boards, tasks and comments. The project focuses on structured REST APIs, authentication, object-level permissions and the integration of an existing frontend with a Django backend.

join.description: Kanban task management application developed as part of a Scrum team. We coordinated our work using a shared KanMind board and collaborated through GitHub for development and version control.

pokedex.description: Pokédex web application built with API integration. The project focuses on working with external data sources, dynamic rendering and interactive user interface behavior.

bestellApp.description: Ordering app for practicing shopping cart functionality and more advanced business logic in JavaScript. The project helped deepen my understanding of state handling and interactive frontend behavior.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Got a problem to solve?
contact.description: Looking for support with a web application? I combine fullstack development with many years of experience in communication, sales, and collaboration with customers and teams.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains which personal data is processed when you visit this website or contact me.

general.title: 2. General information on data processing
general.text: Personal data is processed only where necessary to operate and secure this website, respond to enquiries, or comply with a legal obligation.

hosting.title: 3. Hosting
hosting.text: This website is hosted by the following hosting provider:
hosting.processing: A data processing agreement is in place with the hosting provider. According to the contractual agreement, data processed as part of the hosting service is processed in Germany.
hosting.legalBasis: The legal basis for using the hosting service is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is the secure and reliable provision of this website.

serverData.title: 4. Technical connection and security data
serverData.logs: Web server log files and web statistics are disabled for this hosting account.
serverData.technical: When a website is accessed, connection data, in particular the IP address of the requesting device, must nevertheless be processed to the extent necessary to transmit the website and to operate and secure the technical infrastructure. The hosting provider may process such data as part of technical security measures.
serverData.legalBasis: The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is the secure and reliable operation of the website.

contactForm.title: 5. Contact form
contactForm.text: If you use the contact form, the information you enter is transmitted to the server and used to process your enquiry. The following data is processed:
contactForm.name: Name
contactForm.acknowledgement: Confirmation that the privacy policy has been acknowledged
contactForm.noConsent: Acknowledging the privacy policy does not constitute consent to data processing within the meaning of Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. It merely ensures that these privacy notices have been acknowledged before the form is submitted.
contactForm.legalBasis: Where your enquiry concerns steps prior to entering into a contract, processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR. Other enquiries are processed on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is the processing of and response to incoming enquiries.

emailCommunication.title: 6. Email communication
emailCommunication.allInkl: Messages submitted through the contact form are delivered to the email mailbox kontakt@juergen-malinowski.de hosted by ALL-INKL.COM. This mailbox contains the message used for handling the enquiry.
emailCommunication.gmx: To ensure reliable notification of newly received messages, an additional copy is forwarded to a GMX mailbox belonging to the controller. The GMX service is operated by:
emailCommunication.deletion: The copy forwarded to GMX is deleted as soon as processing of the message begins in the ALL-INKL mailbox. The original message remains in the ALL-INKL mailbox while the enquiry is being handled.
emailCommunication.legalBasis: Depending on the nature of the enquiry, the legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest includes ensuring that incoming messages are reliably noticed and processed.

storage.title: 7. Storage period
storage.text: Contact and email data is deleted once the communication has ended and the matter concerned has been conclusively resolved, unless statutory retention obligations require continued storage.

recipients.title: 8. Recipients and service providers
recipients.text: Personal data is disclosed only to the service providers identified in this privacy policy where necessary for hosting, email communication and technical operation, or where disclosure is required by law.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies, analytics and tracking
cookies.text: In its current technical configuration, this website does not use analytics or marketing services and does not set its own tracking cookies. No user tracking for advertising or marketing purposes takes place.

externalLinks.title: 10. External links
externalLinks.text: This website contains links to external services, in particular GitHub and LinkedIn. Content from these providers is not embedded in the website. A connection to the respective provider is established only when you follow an external link. The respective provider is responsible for any subsequent processing of personal data.

thirdCountries.title: 11. Transfers to third countries
thirdCountries.text: The operator of this website does not intentionally transfer personal data to recipients outside the European Union or the European Economic Area. When external links are opened, the respective external providers may transfer data in accordance with their own privacy policies.

security.title: 12. SSL/TLS encryption
security.text: This website is provided through an encrypted HTTPS connection. This helps protect data transmitted between your browser and the web server against unauthorised access.

rights.title: 13. Your rights
rights.intro: Where the statutory requirements are met, the GDPR provides you in particular with the following rights:
rights.access: Right of access to your personal data
rights.rectification: Right to rectification of inaccurate data
rights.erasure: Right to erasure of your data
rights.objection: Right to object to processing based on legitimate interests
rights.contact: To exercise your rights, you can contact kontakt@juergen-malinowski.de.

complaint.title: 14. Right to lodge a complaint
complaint.text: Under Art. 77 GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of your personal data infringes the GDPR.
complaint.authority: For controllers established in Lower Saxony, the State Commissioner for Data Protection of Lower Saxony is in particular a competent supervisory authority.

automatedDecision.title: 15. Automated decision-making
automatedDecision.text: No solely automated decision-making, including profiling, takes place on this website.
